description: This Java class 'SimpleMapProcess' handles processing of string operations on a specified field, including reading operation configurations from XML elements and executing them on input data maps.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcess
classes.description: Main class for processing string operations on a specified field, including reading operation configurations and executing them.

methods.name: SimpleMapProcess
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the process with an XML element defining the operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes all configured string operations on the input map, producing results and messages.

methods.description: Returns the name of the field to process.

methods.name: readOperations
